summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path_value helper, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection after the Utilities automodule in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Choices made: a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError; a non-mapping top-level JSON value is treated as a missing key; malformed JSON is not caught (json.JSONDecodeError is a ValueError subclass); items are shallow-copied before resolution. Not verified: tests were not run and black/flake8 were not run per instructions; line lengths were checked by awk and none exceed 120. Nothing was committed.
